dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge spline with maximum curvature centered in the middle third of the margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute-to-slightly-rounded apex with a small pixel radius, leaning posteriorly.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree linear ascent from the anterior dorsal ridge base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base-to-height ratio of approximately 1:1.2 based on visible pixel extent.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow, large-radius convex curve transitioning smoothly from the blowhole region toward the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust visible segment with high thickness-to-length ratio before terminating at image boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle visible at the transition point between the melon slope and the superior rostrum surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular white depigmentation patch (approx. 50x40 pixels) on the lower mid-body flank; several small dark punctate lesions on the dorsal fin and upper flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct tripartite pigmentation pattern featuring a dark dorsal cape, a lighter grey thoracic patch, and a bright white ventral-posterior field.
